evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label and adds the util::NotNull template wrapper in src/util/not_null.h.
rationale: Adds a reusable utility to document and enforce non-null invariants at compile-time across the codebase. As stated in the description, it 'documents (and checks) that the inner pointer is never null' and 'removes the need to Assert() the pointer before dereference', providing worthwhile type-safety ergonomics without addressing an active bug.
